shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone surface
figures arranged in a horizontal row/register
repeated identical motifs in a band
justification: Both surfaces use low relief organised into horizontal registers with a row of repeated profile forms — animals in A, human tribute-bearers in B — and both include a top band of repeated small motifs. But the depicted content diverges almost entirely: A shows schematic, disproportionate animals (a large-headed carnivore, a crouching quadruped, a long-necked bird) with no human actors and no interaction, while B shows naturalistic, uniformly proportioned clothed men in procession carrying vessels and touching hands, a scheme with no counterpart in A.
